ValidationRule.description: SS-299 We want to only allow 2 values for the Partner Type
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( IF(INCLUDES( Partner_Type__c , "Consultant"), 1,0) + IF(INCLUDES( Partner_Type__c , "Distributor"), 1,0)+ IF(INCLUDES( Partner_Type__c , "Managed Services Provider"), 1,0) + IF(INCLUDES( Partner_Type__c , "Reseller"), 1,0) + IF(INCLUDES( Partner_Type__c , "System Integrator"), 1,0) + IF(INCLUDES( Partner_Type__c , "Technology Alliance"), 1,0) > 2)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This field allows a maximum of 2 choices.
